create_websocket_agent: create a WebsocketAgent instance with opt, manager, receiver_id, and task_id parameters
send_message_via_observe: send a message to a websocket agent using the observe method with text or payload
queue_incoming_message: queue an incoming websocket message into the agent using the put_data method
send_image_payload: send a base64 encoded image through the observe method using a payload dict with type and data keys
send_quick_replies: send a message with quick replies by including a quick_replies list in the act dict
